parameters.content:
## 1. Setup and dedupe
Config holds every setting (Sheet ID, keywords, sources, models, limits).
The three Sheet reads load the prompt library and every URL already processed, so nothing is checked or messaged twice.

## 2. Collect and pre-filter
Public APIs only: Remotive, Jobicy, Himalayas (no LinkedIn, no HTML scraping).
Rules drop obvious mismatches for free before any LLM call.

## 3. Claude validates
Forced tool use returns strict JSON: remote, English-speaking, relevant, plus personalisation details.

## 4. Claude writes outreach
Prompt comes from the Sheet "Prompts" tab. Several Active rows = automatic A/B test.

## 5. Audit trail
Every rejected posting is logged with its reason in "Filtered Out".
